name: CD74 molecule
pathways: positive regulation of canonical NF-kappaB signal transduction
negative regulation of DNA damage response, signal transduction by p53 class mediator

function.text: CD74 encodes HLA class II histocompatibility antigen gamma chain [Cleaved into: Class-II-associated invariant chain peptide]. Annotated molecular activities include cytokine receptor activity and protein folding chaperone. It participates in positive regulation of canonical NF-kappaB signal transduction and negative regulation of DNA damage response, signal transduction by p53 class mediator.
